snippets.label: Continue
snippets.text: Continue from where you left off. Do not recap unless something is blocked.

snippets.label: Fix error
snippets.text: Read the error in this pane and fix it. Only ask if you need a secret or a destructive choice.

snippets.label: Review diff
snippets.text: Review the uncommitted diff. List bugs, missing tests, and anything I should not ship.

snippets.label: Write tests
snippets.text: Add tests that cover the current change, then run them.

snippets.label: Explain
snippets.text: Explain what this pane is showing in a few sentences.

snippets.label: Summarize
snippets.text: Summarize the files you changed and why, then stop.

snippets.label: Next steps
snippets.text: Propose the next three steps. Wait for me before changing more files.

snippets.label: Stop
snippets.text: Stop. Do not change anything else. Recap where we are and what is still open.
